headline: Axia Energia Approves R$6 Billion Redemption of Class C Preferred Shares
summary: Axia Energia's board of administration approved the redemption of nearly 130 million Class C preferred shares in an operation valued at R$6 billion, offering investors conversion or cash payout options.
why: Large capital restructuring and share redemptions alter a utility company's equity capital structure and shareholder distributions.

impacts.name: Axia Energia
impacts.why: Share redemptions directly alter outstanding equity volume and capital allocation.
